recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed unless a future generated build regresses; if that happens, the fix should be made in current Kindling/publisher tooling rather than retired in-repository Java tooling.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Feed issue raised against DSTU2 and applied for STU3. The reporter noted that the Bundle transaction XML sample page lacked `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>` and asked that this be fixed in tooling wherever the same issue existed.
initial_application: Jira records `svn 14819`; Git commit 2d6d6397e018c7481fd21145a2b280195cda1fbf (`GF#13178 - fix example xml`) maps to that SVN revision and added an escaped XML declaration to the old XhtmlGenerator.java XML example rendering path. That old Java tooling was subsequently moved under implementations/java/old and removed in the 2019 refactor.
additional_context: Bundle remains active in source/fhir.ini, and source/bundle/bundle-transaction.xml starts with the requested XML declaration. The current build uses the external org.hl7.fhir:kindling publisher dependency rather than the retired in-repository XhtmlGenerator.java file. Current build.fhir.org and hl7.org generated pages for bundle-transaction.xml.html show the escaped declaration, and build.fhir.org/bundle-transaction.xml begins with the raw declaration. FHIR-I minutes from 2018-07-09 corroborate the Persuasive disposition; community searches found no conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative source example is in build scope and already contains the declaration, the current generated/public surfaces satisfy the issue, and the historical tooling target no longer exists in the current checkout.
